entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Sure. It's for Sarah Jenkins, order 788-B451.

Thank you, Sarah. I see you ordered the VeloBand GPS Tracker. Let me just pull up the details... Okay. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Are you experiencing a technical fault or is it more of a preference?
It's broken. The main reason I bought it is not working at all.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me a little more about what's not working?
The pulse tracking. It's completely defective. The data won't sync, and half the time it doesn't even register a reading. The whole thing is basically broken.

I understand your frustration. A feature like that not functioning correctly would be very disappointing. Let me check the return eligibility for you. I see the item was delivered on December 15th, which was 31 days ago.

Just one moment while I review our policy... Okay, thanks for your patience. According to our system, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can go ahead and process this return for you immediately.
Whatever. Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the defective item back at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a good day.
